taxonomy.description: Cause -> effect: an event or object causes another event or object.
Instrument -> agent: an agent uses an instrument to act. A component of an object alone is Component-Whole.
Product -> producer: a producer makes or creates a product.
Content -> container: an object is physically stored in a delimited container, a static situation. Movement into a destination is Entity-Destination.
Entity -> origin: an entity comes or is derived from an origin or source.
Entity -> destination: an entity moves towards a destination.
Component -> whole: an object is a functional or structural part of a larger whole.
Member -> collection: a member is a nonfunctional part of a collection or group, rather than a structural component.
Message -> topic: a written or spoken message communicates about a topic.
